name: Inaka-gurashi Harem ~Kyonyuu na Inaka Musume-tachi to Hitasura Haramase Sex Suru Dake no Seikatsu~
original_name: 田舎暮らしハーレム～巨乳な田舎娘たちとひたすら孕ませセックスするだけの性活～
source:
Fresh off the bus home, and the busty bounty of the countryside is already there to welcome you! You thought only Shizuru would be there to pick you up, but apparently, a new arrival is big enough news to draw two more hotties to the scene.

Less than a minute in and he’s almost hit a line on a ‘hentai babes bingo card’!

Nao, a dazzling blonde gyaru, Yuu with her tanned tomboy vibe, and the sensibly stylish Shizuru, who may or may not have a secret slutty side. Now all we’re missing is a sassy Tsundere and a timid, quiet type to corrupt with perverted techniques!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4468740/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
刚从回家的巴士上下来，乡村的巨乳已经在那里欢迎你了！你以为只有静会来接你，但显然，新来的人已经是大新闻了，足以吸引另外两位帅哥到场。

不到一分钟，他就差点撞到一张“无尽美女宾果卡”上的线了！

Nao，一个令人眼花缭乱的金发辣妹，Yuu，有着晒黑的假小子气质，还有时尚感十足的Shizuru，她可能有也可能没有秘密放荡的一面。现在我们所缺少的只是一个时髦的傲娇和一个胆怯、安静、会用变态手段腐蚀的人！
